title: Cancelling Maybe concatenation prevents later subscription side effects
summary: Early cancellation prevented entry into the second successful Maybe. With an empty prefix, both the iterable and array forms entered just the empty and first value sources.

change.description: RxJava 2 rechecks cancellation before moving from an emitted Maybe value to the next source. A downstream that has already accepted its first element can thereby prevent later subscriptions.

notes: An empty source cannot satisfy firstElement. The cancellation point depends on the first actual value and is independent of array versus iterable representation.
With identical compiled caller bytes, 2.0.6 matched the parent and 2.0.7 matched the landing on all three histories.
